overviewHtml:
Cloud security findings pile up in AWS Security Hub, and teams cannot easily tell which misconfigurations matter. This package uses Kiro CLI and Dynatrace to triage, validate and remediate them.

What you get

  • AI-assisted verification of cloud misconfigurations using Dynatrace runtime context
  • AI-assisted remediation of confirmed misconfigurations
  • Jira ticket creation based on AWS Security Hub integration
  • Two scenarios: Kiro CLI-based and Dynatrace-driven triaging
getStartedHtml:
You need Kiro CLI, AWS Security Hub, Jira and a Dynatrace environment.

  1. Add the agent and instruction files to Kiro CLI
  2. Import the Dynatrace workflow template for Security Hub triaging
  3. Choose a triaging scenario and run it

Full setup instructions are in the README.
